subject: Action Required: owner-of-record snapshot + SCIM delta workback for SOC2 evidence
messages:
From: Julia Perez <julia.perez@bluecrest.com>
To: logan_wright@redwood.ai
Cc: Audit Team <audit@bluecrest.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Sep 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request: owner-of-record snapshot + SCIM deltas for entitlement lineage

Hi Logan,

Thanks for taking this. For our SOC2 audit we need a short workback and the following artifacts to validate least-privilege and provisioning provenance for BlueCrest's tenant:

- Owner-of-record snapshot (current) for all roles and service accounts; CSV + a mapping sheet that lists owner email and owner type (team/user).
- SCIM delta export for the last 90 days with tombstone flags and event IDs (create/update/delete).
- Service-account lifecycle manifest (creation date, last rotation, linked keys, provisioning source).
- Role-to-permission mapping (human-readable) and any recent role prunings in the period.
- Sampling of SAML assertion logs (just the assertion IDs and timestamps, redacted PII is fine).

Can you confirm scope: production tenant only, and whether you can include the event IDs (we use them to tie SCIM deltas back to CloudTrail during the audit). We also need a short narrative (one page) describing how you enforce least privilege and handle just-in-time admin elevation.

If possible we’d like the artifacts by EOD Thu 24 Sep. Please let me know if that timeline is feasible.

Thanks,
Julia Perez
Senior IT Auditor
BlueCrest Health

--

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Perez <julia.perez@bluecrest.com>
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 21 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request: owner-of-record snapshot + SCIM deltas for entitlement lineage

Julia —

Got it, will take this on. Scope confirmed: production tenant only unless you explicitly want staging too (note: staging has different owner tags).

Plan / owners:
- SCIM delta and event-id export: Aditya (aditya_rao) — will pull raw deltas and include tombstone flags.
- Owner-of-record snapshot + mapping sheet: Naomi (naomi_feldman) — will generate CSV and owner matrix.
- Service-account lifecycle manifest + role-to-permission matrix: Grace (grace_oconnor) — will extract service account metadata and role docs.
- SAML assertion sample: I’ll pull the assertion IDs and timestamps and redact PII.

Proposed timeline: initial bundle uploaded to a secure Drive link by Wed 23 Sep COB; full narrative + final artifacts by Thu 24 Sep EOD. If any item needs more time we’ll flag on Wed morning.

Two quick clarifications for scope:
1) Do you want just the active accounts or the last-90-day history for accounts that were disabled/deleted? We can include both, but the history increases export size.
2) For service accounts should we include keys/secrets metadata (rotations, last-used) or only lifecycle timestamps? We will redact secrets of course.

If that plan works I’ll have Aditya and Naomi start the exports now.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Head of Compliance Ops
Redwood Inference

Hi all —

Upload status and questions:
- I’ve started the owner-of-record export. Deliverables prepared: owner-of-record-mapping_v1.xlsx (columns: principal_id, principal_type, role, owner_email, owner_team, owner_role, owner_assigned_at).
- I’ll include both active and deleted (disabled) accounts with a status column; deleted rows will have deleted_at timestamp.
- ETA: I can upload the initial CSV + mapping sheet to the Drive link by Wed 23 Sep 02:00 PM PT.

Questions for Julia:
1) For owner assignments, do you want to see historical owner changes (owner timeline) or current owner with an included last-owner-change timestamp? Historical owner timelines are feasible but add time to redaction.
2) For role-to-permission mapping: do you prefer a flattened mapping (one row per role-permission) or a hierarchical workbook with a sheet per role?

Attachments I will put on Drive: scim-delta-exports-20260921.csv (partial, first 7 days), owner-of-record-mapping_v1.xlsx (first pass).

Grace: flagging you for service-account manifests + permission matrix — can you confirm you’ll attach the manifest PDF and a short justification doc?

Aditya: can you include event IDs in the SCIM export (I’m going to reference them in the mapping)?

Thanks — will follow up after upload.

Naomi

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 22 Sep 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Evidence package uploaded: owner-of-record + SCIM delta (drive link)

Julia —

We uploaded the initial evidence bundle to the secure Drive folder and attached the smaller artifacts to this thread (see attachments). Summary of what’s in the folder:

- scim-delta-exports-20260921.csv (full 90-day delta with event_id, tombstone_flag, actor_principal)
- owner-of-record-mapping_v1.xlsx (current snapshot + deleted status column)
- owner-of-record-change-timeline_sample.csv (sample of owner change history for top 50 roles)
- service-account-lifecycle-manifest.pdf (creation/rotation/last-used notes for prod service accounts)
- role_permission_flattened.csv (one row per role-permission)
- saml-assertion-sample_ids.txt (assertion IDs + timestamps, no PII)

Notes / redactions we performed: account emails were redacted for personal emails where required, but owner_team and owner_role were preserved. Keys and secrets are omitted; rotation timestamps are included.

Next steps:
- Please review the Drive folder and let us know two available 30-min windows for a walkthrough (we recommend Wed 24 Sep 09:00-11:00 PT or Thu 24 Sep 13:00-15:00 PT).
- If you need owner-change history for more roles beyond the sample, we can produce a full timeline export — allow 48 hours.

For convenience I’ve attached the three smaller files to this message: scim-delta-exports-20260921.csv (excerpt, 1.2MB), owner-of-record-mapping_v1.xlsx (summary sheet), service-account-lifecycle-manifest.pdf (3 pages).

Thanks and stand by for any follow-ups.

Best,
Logan
